title: Duplicate billing review policy
content: Verify payment processor records, invoice ids, billing cycle, and account credits before refund action.

title: Password reset and MFA policy
content: Send a secure reset link, verify MFA status, and never ask for a password in chat.

title: Checkout troubleshooting
content: Collect screenshot, browser, device, timestamp, account id, and cart id before routing to product support.

title: Cancellation retention policy
content: Confirm account owner, billing impact, data export needs, and route enterprise cancellations to human review.

title: Shipping delay support
content: Check tracking status, carrier events, address changes, and SLA window before offering replacement.
